schema: key_name_regex: case-insensitive regex tested against the parameter KEY; a string value under a matching key is masked. value_regexes: tested against a string VALUE (search) = bearer text, credential-bearing connection string. whole_token_regex: a string value that is ENTIRELY one key-like token (fullmatch) is masked; URLs and SQL never fullmatch it, so they are copied. expression_regexes: for values starting with '=' (n8n expressions) only these are searched. allow_regexes: tokens that are allowed to appear (git shas); fullmatch.
